instructions: A hand-built clockwork workshop at miniature scale, with a timber-and-stone base, visible framing, individually joined wall boards, standing-seam roof wings, a riveted dark-iron boiler, copper pressure lines, an exposed flywheel, a usable workbench, and warm glazed openings. Keep the roof open enough to read its machinery from strategy view. Materials should show grain, worn iron, aged copper, and restrained brass under RoomScale lighting.
tool: Blender background authoring through the RoomScale Art Factory generator
post_processing: apply manufactured edge bevel and weighted normals
unwrap authored components with scale-aware UVs
export GLB with embedded base-colour, roughness, and tangent-normal textures
material_method: Embedded, per-material PBR base-colour, roughness, and tangent-normal maps, with separate timber, stone, iron, copper, brass, and glazing responses.

import_configuration.format: GLB PackedScene with embedded PBR textures
import_configuration.axes: Blender X width / Y depth / Z up exported to Godot X width / Y up / Z depth
import_configuration.normalization: fit source geometry to ArtBrief dimensions without altering RoomDefinition
